title: Job first: the preamble roster and bee team show lead with the role and its description
action:
Read plan.md revision 2 (D1, D4) and CONTEXT.md first. `declared_model_for` from lst-1 is the one source of the model for a herding or cli slot.

**The preamble roster** (`hooks/model_guard.rs`):
- `role_slot_display` (`:463-465`) takes only the `team` subtree; give it the whole config (its caller `dispatch_door_lines` at `:520` already holds the loaded map) so it can call the helper.
- `render_role` (`:417`) returns `<model> (native)` for a native slot, `<declared-model> (herding: <agent>)` for a herding slot with a declared model, `model chosen by the agent (herding: <agent>)` when none is declared, `<declared-model> (cli)` for a cli slot.
- `dispatch_door_lines` (`:520-545`) prints one line per role — `- <role> → <render_role>` — for EVERY role, no descriptions, each line ≤ 60 characters (truncate the transport tail with `…` if needed, never the role or model), and retires `DOOR_ROLES_SHOWN` (`:346`) and the `+N more` tail. Keep the trailing `open set: any name team.<runtime> configures is legal…` sentence as its own final line.
- Update every test that asserts the old `- Roles (claude): a=b | c=d` shape (`:2882`, `:2888`, `:2917` and siblings); add one asserting all 18 roles of a fixture appear and no line exceeds 60 chars.

**`bee team show`** (`verbs/models_group.rs`):
- Render through `resolve_role` + `declared_model_for` instead of `slot_display`'s raw JSON: aligned columns `role  [source]  description  model  transport`, in that order (description may be empty; the order never changes). `--json` keeps the raw `slot` and adds `model` and `transport` fields.
- `TEACH` (`:48`) opens with `team — who does which job. …` and tells the reader to pick by the description column.
- Update the asserting tests (`:456` and siblings).

Do NOT touch the economics code, prepare.rs, or any doc.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- model_guard models_group session_preamble compaction

truths: the roster prints every configured role, one per line, role then model then transport, no descriptions, no line over 60 characters
a herding slot with no declared model prints a plain phrase, never a status word
bee team show columns are role, source, description, model, transport — in that order — on claude and pi
team show --json still carries the raw slot
no economics or prepare code is touched
